solution:
import cv2, numpy as np

def find_harris_points(gray: np.ndarray, ratio: float = 0.1):
    resp = cv2.cornerHarris(gray.astype(np.float32), blockSize=3, ksize=3, k=0.04)
    mask = (resp > ratio * resp.max()).astype(np.uint8)
    _, _, _, centroids = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask)
    return centroids[1:]  # Abaikan background label 0
